chapters.title: Chapter 1:  In which Mr Benedict Nail, who does not approve of Christmas, neighbours or music, finds himself assailed by all three and does not enjoy it
Chapter 2: In which Mr Benedict Nail gets a present for which he is not in the least bit grateful
Chapter 3: In which Mr Benedict Nail finds himself in a predicament which is both small and, consequently, also completely overwhelming
Chapter 4: In which Mr Benedict Nail finds that the souvenirs on his mantlepiece do not remind him of anything very pleasant
Chapter 5: In which Mr Benedict Nail seeks sanctuary in the unlikely location of a tiny china cottage on his mantlepiece
Chapter 6: In which Mr Benedict Nail trapped in an unhappy present, is reminded of an unhappy past
Chapter 7: In which Mr Benedict Nail realises that, surrounded by mementoes, he rapidly forgetting what they mean
Chapter 8: In which Mr Benedict Nail is taken before the beak and learns some startling facts about his predicament
Chapter 9: In which Mr Benedict Nail learns that cats do not have owners, they have servants, who merely there to feed them. Sometimes literally.
Chapter 10: In which Mr Benedict Nail gets lost in a good book
Chapter 11: In which Mr Benedict Nail finally meets someone who seems to know what he should do next
Chapter 12: In which Mr Benedict Nail spills everything to a flatfoot
Chapter 13: In which Mr Benedict Nail quite forgets himself
Chapter 14: In which Mr Benedict Nail regains at least some of his senses
Chapter 15: In which Mr Benedict Nail escapes from a place of learning by going down a mine
Chapter 16: In which Mr Benedict Nail discovers that maybe he should try and organise his nonsense drawer some day
Chapter 17: In which Mr Benedict Nail discovers the true nonsense in the depths of the nonsense drawer
Chapter 18: In which Mr Benedict Nail rides out with a goblin king - much against his better judgement
Chapter 19: In which Mr Benedict Nail discovers a secret, glorious haven amongst all the nonsense
Chapter 20: In which Mr Benedict Nail goes on a dangerous mission and is reminded why he has never done this before
Chapter 21: In which Mr Benedict Nail is finally reunited with the present he so carelessly discarded
Chapter 22: In which Mr Benedict Nail discovers that the spirits have done it all in one night
Chapter 23: In which Mr Benedict Nail decides that, after all, he really does like Christmas, neighbours and music
Chapter 24: In which Mr Benedict Nail has a happy Christmas and wishes one to everyone else, too. Including you.
